target.title: Do not fabricate a 0% Gemini primary window when there is no Pro tier
target.body:
`GeminiStatusSnapshot.toUsageSnapshot()` builds the primary (Pro) window as:

```swift
let primary = RateWindow(
    usedPercent: proMin.map { 100 - $0.percentLeft } ?? 0,
    ...)
```

The `?? 0` fabricates a 0%-used primary window when the account has no Pro-tier quota, whereas `secondary` (Flash) and `tertiary` (Flash Lite) correctly become `nil` via `.map`.

`MenuBarMetricWindowResolver.automaticWindow` has no `.gemini` case, so Gemini falls through to the default `return snapshot.primary ?? snapshot.secondary`. Because primary is never nil, the phantom 0% window always wins over the real Flash usage in `secondary` - so a Flash-only account (free tier, or any account whose quota response has no model id containing "pro") that is 95% used displays "0% used".

Fix: build `primary` via `.map` like `secondary`/`tertiary`, so it is `nil` when there is no Pro quota. The real Flash window then surfaces through the existing `primary ?? secondary` fallback.

## Real behavior proof

Built a throwaway executable (not part of this PR) that runs a real `gemini /stats` table with only Flash tiers through the public `GeminiStatusProbe.parse(text:)` and inspects `toUsageSnapshot()`, on `main` vs this branch. Input: Flash at 5% left (95% used), Flash Lite at 60% left.

Before (main):
```
modelQuotas: ["gemini-2.5-flash=5.0%left", "gemini-2.5-flash-lite=60.0%left"]
primary   -> usedPercent=0.0   (phantom Pro window; menu bar reads "0% used")
secondary -> usedPercent=95.0
tertiary  -> usedPercent=40.0
```

After (this branch):
```
modelQuotas: ["gemini-2.5-flash=5.0%left", "gemini-2.5-flash-lite=60.0%left"]
primary   -> nil   (no fabricated window; the real 95%-used Flash surfaces via primary ?? secondary)
secondary -> usedPercent=95.0
tertiary  -> usedPercent=40.0
```

Testing: added tests for a Flash-only snapshot (primary == nil, real Flash usage preserved in secondary) and a Pro-present snapshot (primary still populated). The Flash-only case fails on the old code (primary is a 0%-used window) and passes after the fix. The Gemini probe/plan/API, menu-card, and MenuBarMetricWindowResolver suites (70 tests) stay green.
